Proforma or commercial invoice? 📦

They look alike, but they do different jobs.

📝 Proforma invoice: sent before shipping. It confirms the order, for a deposit, a letter of credit or an import licence.
🚢 Commercial invoice: goes with the goods. Customs uses it, with values, HS codes and origin.

Make both with your logo and export to PDF, Word or Excel. Free, no sign-up.
